summary: Executed backend pytest regression and frontend E2E validation for pt-BR/es locale switch, persistence, responsive behavior, contact/mailto, 3D flows, and admin/article/upload regressions on public preview URL.

ui_bugs.issue: Interactive admin controls/inputs still lack data-testid attributes, reducing selector stability and maintainability for required automated regressions.

integration_issues.issue: Console repeatedly logs GLTF parse failures (Unexpected token '<') and failed model loads. Direct check shows /assets/3d/GI014.glb responds with content-type text/html instead of model/gltf-binary, breaking at least one model in carousel.
React warning detected: defaultMuted/defaultmuted prop warning from PingPongVideo usage.

action_items: Fix static asset serving for /assets/3d/GI014.glb (must return valid GLB bytes + model/gltf-binary content-type).
Resolve React defaultMuted warning in PingPongVideo to keep console clean.
Add data-testid to admin auth/dashboard interactive controls for stable E2E coverage.
After fixes, rerun Gi Reboot/EVA 3D carousel traversal and console checks.
critical_code_review_comments: Hardcoded admin credentials in backend/server.py remain a security risk for production-grade auth (preexisting behavior).
Admin pages do not follow data-testid testability convention used across public pages.
3D asset delivery inconsistency (GI014 served as HTML) indicates static hosting/routing mismatch for binary model files.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST articles via API and UI; all cleaned up during test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Locale switch/persistence/responsive/menu/contact/mailto/admin CRUD/upload regressions were executed on public URL. Most flows pass. Focus next run on 3D model asset integrity (especially GI014.glb) and post-fix console clean run.
rca of the issue: Root cause for 3D failure is likely incorrect static file mapping or missing/corrupted GI014.glb artifact: endpoint returns HTTP 200 but content-type text/html and GLTF parser receives HTML (<!doctype ...>), causing runtime parse exception in Viewer3D. Repro: open /gi-reboot, switch locale optionally, interact with carousel -> console shows 'Falha ao carregar modelo 3D: SyntaxError Unexpected token <'.
